company.name: Ancana
company.shortDescription: Marketplace where people can buy a fully managed vacation home through co-ownership.
company.description:
Ancana is a marketplace where people can buy, sell and enjoy a fully managed vacation home through co-ownership. We partner with top developers around the world to implement a co-ownership product into their developments, offering a 5 star hospitality service to owners.
Ancana takes care of everything that makes purchasing and owning a vacation home complicated while enjoying the great benefits owning a piece of it. Ancana uses technology to to manage and make scheduling your nights seamless and simple.

productsAndServices.description: Allows customers to buy a share of a vacation home, granting legal ownership and usage rights for a portion of the year.
productsAndServices.name: Fractional Ownership Vacation Homes

productsAndServices.description: Manages cleaning, maintenance, and upkeep of the vacation homes to ensure a hassle-free ownership experience for co-owners.
productsAndServices.name: Property Management and Maintenance Services

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that allows co-owners to select usage weeks, manage bookings, and coordinate property use efficiently.
productsAndServices.name: Owners’ Portal for Scheduling and Management

productsAndServices.description: Provides personalized assistance to owners for booking services and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable stay at their vacation home.
productsAndServices.name: Concierge Services

productsAndServices.description: Manages the rental of owners’ unused weeks, handling guest bookings and maximizing rental income on behalf of owners.
productsAndServices.name: Rental Management Program

productsAndServices.description: Enables owners to exchange their usage weeks for stays at over 15,000 luxury properties worldwide through a partnership with ThirdHome.
productsAndServices.name: Global Home Exchange Program

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,900,000, or 89.23% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,950,000 to $17,721,464, a 4.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 26 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Pacaso, Kocomo, ThirdHome.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
